description: Realtime data for the last 30 minutes (60 on GA4 360): active users and events right now. Good for checking that a tracking change is live. Only realtime dimensions/metrics are allowed (see the dimensions description).

dimension_filter.description: List of conditions that must ALL match (AND). An item can also be {"any": [conditions]} for OR. Each condition: {field, op, value}, optionally "not": true. Example: [{"field": "eventName", "op": "exact", "value": "purchase"}, {"field": "country", "op": "in_list", "values": ["Poland"], "not": true}, {"any": [{"field": "pagePath", "op": "begins_with", "value": "/shop"}, {"field": "pagePath", "op": "contains", "value": "product"}]}]

case_sensitive.description: String ops and in_list only. Default false.

field.description: Dimension or metric API name, e.g. "eventName", "pagePath", "sessionDefaultChannelGroup", "sessions".

op.description: String ops: exact, contains, begins_with, ends_with, full_regex (RE2, whole value), partial_regex; in_list (uses "values"); numeric ops: eq, lt, lte, gt, gte (use a number "value"), between (uses "from"/"to"); empty (value is empty / not set).

value.description: Value to compare with (string ops and numeric ops).

any.description: At least one of these conditions must match (OR).

dimensions.description: Realtime dimension API names (a limited set), e.g. "eventName", "unifiedScreenName", "country", "city", "deviceCategory", "platform", "minutesAgo". List: https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/reporting/data/v1/realtime-api-schema

limit.description: Max rows to return. Default 100. The result says when more rows exist (next_offset).

minute_ranges.description: Default: the last 30 minutes. Two ranges are allowed (e.g. last 5 vs last 30 minutes).

start_minutes_ago.description: e.g. 29 (standard properties: up to 29, 360: up to 59).

dimension_order.description: For dimensions only. Use numeric for e.g. "date" or "hour"-like dimensions stored as strings.

field.description: A dimension or metric from this request.

property_id.description: GA4 property ID, e.g. "123456789" or "properties/123456789" (not the G-XXXX measurement ID). get_account_summaries lists them.

return_property_quota.description: Include the property quota status in the result.
